mission.goal: Add a keyless, tenant-pinned Gemini Vertex route to the existing Federation Omega operator without weakening its current controls.
mission.workflow: Canonical-source verification, documentation gate, isolated patch, failure-first tests, Airlock-governed promotion, provider-native readback.
mission.data: Public operator source and synthetic exact-nonce fixtures only; no client content or provider credentials.
mission.interface: Authenticated Federation Omega JSON actions over the existing Cloud Run HTTP service.
mission.stack: Node.js 20+ standard library and Google REST APIs.
mission.environment: Isolated local test workspace; provider calls disabled during build validation.
mission.governance: Formation-gated, keyless service identity, exact target and tenant allowlists, no silent fallback.
mission.failure: Fail closed on authentication absence, target drift, model drift, tenant drift, disabled semantic gate, provider error or nonce mismatch.
mission.testing: Twenty-one Node tests plus syntax checks, secret scan and restored-source baseline verification.
mission.deployment: Not yet deployed; promotion requires Airlock-admitted pull request and trusted Google deployment identity.
mission.continuity: Existing v2 image remains rollback baseline; new semantic execution is environment-disabled by default.

assumptions.runtime: Existing Federation Omega Cloud Run service
assumptions.storage: No new storage for capability or semantic canary actions
assumptions.authentication: Existing Secret Manager token or Google-signed OIDC for operator ingress; Cloud Run service identity for Vertex
assumptions.deployment: Existing private deployment plane or authenticated Google-native deployer

components.backend: Federation Omega operator action router and GoogleCloudAdapter
components.database: Not applicable for bounded canary actions
components.authentication: Keyless Cloud Run service identity to Vertex AI

observability.health_checks: existing operator health and authenticated status actions
observability.structured_logs: operator action status plus provider-safe response metadata
observability.audit_logs: existing Cloud Run request logs and provider audit logs
observability.metrics_alerts: capability status, nonce verification and token usage readback

testing.unit: Contract and adapter tests for allowlists, disabled gates and response parsing
testing.integration: Action router to mocked provider adapter
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Exact-nonce semantic fixture with no live provider effect
testing.fixtures_mocks: Synthetic project, tenant, model and nonce only
testing.failure_first: Model drift, tenant drift, disabled API, closed semantic gate and nonce mismatch

delivery.file_tree: ops/federation_omega_operator with contracts, action router, Google adapter, tests and operator documentation
deploy_commands: HELD until trusted Google deployment identity and Airlock admission are proven
rollback_commands: Route traffic to the previously ready Cloud Run revision and leave GEMINI_SEMANTIC_CANARY_ENABLED unset
delivery.debugging: Inspect contract error code, provider-safe response, Cloud Run revision logs and exact-nonce readback

watchman.health: All local gates green; provider route not yet deployed
watchman.rollback: Use previous Cloud Run revision; semantic canary is disabled by default

continuity.resume_conditions: Current main SHA, trusted deployment identity and zero-cost capability readback verified
continuity.stop_switch: Unset GEMINI_SEMANTIC_CANARY_ENABLED or roll back Cloud Run revision
